d:
Aksar kaha jata hai ki subah tarotaza mahsus karne ke lie rat men achchhi nind aana zaruri hai. kaee bar doktar aath ghante sone ki bat bhi kahte hain.
Lekin kuchh log aise hote hain jo kam sote hain lekin bilkul riphreshing mud men nazar aate hain. aakhir aisa kaise hota hai, hamari nind se hamare jin ka kya kanekshan hai aur isse juri risarch se aage chalkar kya fayda mil sakta hai?
Riport amanda ruggeri
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
